specificFindings: The three-dimension framework can apply to professional life and could identify some psychologically rich jobs despite lower happiness or meaning. The preceding guess and may remain author interpretations,not a survey finding about every occupation.

The all-inclusive and backpacking options are a contrast and later a metaphor,not instructions to buy travel. Easy relates to company planning;harder includes uncertain accommodations and independent planning,not a guarantee of danger.

Nine refers to countries,while many Americans describes only a subset of participants. Their ideal-life descriptions resembled a cruise;the text does not prove actual cruises or all Americans identical. For many is not every person.

The seventy-hour ride is described as not exactly fun;hours are not days. Youth hostels are what the travellers could afford. Downtown safety comments are limited to the authors 1988 account and are not current travel advice.

In New York a man requested twenty dollars. The nearby bank,the invitation to follow,queue and disappearance are sequenced correctly;the subsequent account calls it a scam. No invented repayment or destination after disappearance is assumed.

The Washington bus arrives in the early morning;the travellers fall asleep on a park bench near the White House and mounted police appear. This episode is distinguished from the separate later tour and Chicago festival.

In Chicago the friend chooses a White Sox game while the narrator wants the Grant Park festival. Conversation precedes an invitation to a house party;only one alcohol occasion is limited to that particular trip. The author slept at the party house and a person he met gave him a ride back to the downtown YMCA the following morning.

The last two exact quotes are restricted to their target sentences;the compiler rejected a longer quote reaching a future unassigned candidate and confirmed the corrected boundaries. Correct option positions were redistributed with Chinese analyses relabelled to match;their substantive reasoning was retained.
